description: Measures GPU shared-memory (LDS/SMEM) read bandwidth: each thread streams 8 independent LDS reads per iteration into 8 independent accumulators, so many accesses are in flight and the LDS unit can be saturated. Launch many blocks (>= number of CUs) to saturate the device. Two access patterns: no_conflict (stride-1) and conflict (32-way bank conflict). Reports bandwidth in GB/s. (For the dependent-access latency variant see shared_mem_latency.)

scaling_param.name: inner_iters
scaling_param.description: Number of inner-loop iterations per kernel launch; controls total shared memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid; must be >= number of CUs to saturate the device for a bandwidth measurement

non_scaling_params.name: access_pattern
non_scaling_params.description: Shared memory access pattern: no_conflict (stride-1) or conflict (same bank)
